subject.title: Tool result channel becomes empty after several calls on 2026.7.1-beta.1

question: Should maintainers accept https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99524 as the fix for this issue based on helper-level saturated-session proof, or require installed-session proof before landing?
rationale: The code path and regression target are clear, but the PR changes which saturated-session context survives and the strongest proof is helper-level rather than a full installed WebChat, Discord, Feishu, or Telegram saturated-session run.

options.title: Accept linked PR proof
options.body: Land the focused PR if preserving current fresh tool output over older projected history is the intended saturated-session behavior.

options.title: Require installed-session proof
options.body: Pause the PR until a redacted installed-session run demonstrates the non-trailing fresh-result shape outside the helper harness.

options.title: Replace with broader fix
options.body: Close or supersede the PR only if maintainers decide a broader recovery design should own both this projection gap and adjacent empty-result causes.

recommendation.title: Accept linked PR proof
recommendation.body: Land the focused PR if preserving current fresh tool output over older projected history is the intended saturated-session behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the adjacent merged same-helper protection that the linked PR extends.
